summary: Remark42 is a self-hosted Go comment engine: users post markdown comments on site/url posts; each comment stores votes/pins/deletion state; admins moderate (delete comments/users, block, verify, pin, set read-only, set titles) and can import/export/remap the site; everything persists into a BoltDB (embedded key-value file) with per-post/comment/user buckets; images and avatars are additional storage blobs.

_auth_candidates.why: _auth_missing fired (no local password); email magic-link auth mirrored via a bridge password column per the external-auth precedent.

_no_edges.why: renders markdown only; no auth wall beyond the open route, calls nothing mutating (rest_private.go:74)
only mints a signed JWT; now modeled as an action.emit into UserLog (rest_private.go:696)
